name: crawl4ai
description: Official Crawl4AI Cloud: a hosted web scraping, extraction, and search API for AI agents. Free API key, 1,000 credits a month, no card. Fully open source: this repo is the Apache-2.0 crawler that powers it, and you can self-host it.
readme: Crawl4AI Cloud is a hosted web scraping, extraction, and search API for AI agents and data pipelines. Turn pages into clean Markdown for RAG, extract structured JSON, or search the live web with one API key. Crawl4AI runs the browsers and manages the proxies. Get a free API key · 1,000 free credits every month. No credit card required.
